reserves.name: USDT-funded spot crypto and corresponding short futures positions
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Aster (Astherus) strategy accounts with Ceffu custody and Binance futures counterparties via Ceffu MirrorX

sources.label: Aster USDF fund custody and risk management

reserveReview.rationale: R02 refresh 2026-08-08 reconfirmed the issuer-documented delta-neutral structure and Ceffu/Binance custody model, with no new public dashboard, attestation, or reserve report publishing retained-USDT, spot-crypto, or futures-margin weights. The product page still describes USDF as backed by crypto assets and corresponding short futures positions with Ceffu custody; the docs still describe USDT mint → Aster Ceffu account → MirrorX 1:1 delegation to a Binance sub-account while assets remain in Ceffu custody, with the strategy buying spot BTC/ETH and shorting matching perpetual notional. Because no supply-weighted split is available and the collateral is an off-exchange, strategy-managed basket, the single reserve is dispositioned as an untracked exogenous hedged-crypto envelope rather than a splittable stablecoin basket.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer-documented delta-neutral backing structure plus independent Ceffu MirrorX custody model; constituent shares are undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The reserve class and counterparties are identified, but Aster does not publish current weights for retained USDT, spot BTC/ETH, or futures-margin exposure.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: USDT-funded spot crypto and corresponding short futures positions
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: USDT funds the delta-neutral strategy, but no current constituent weights support treating any portion of the aggregate basket as direct stablecoin collateral. The strategy is an off-exchange, Ceffu-custodied hedged-crypto envelope and is therefore treated as an untracked exogenous asset.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-4 (lead usdf-falcon)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Aster documents Ceffu custody with MirrorX off-exchange settlement onto Binance, under which assets remain with the custodian while balances are mirrored to the exchange for the delta-neutral strategy. Account-level segregation, insolvency treatment, and the exact scope of assets deployed as futures margin are not established by the reviewed sources.
